description:
FILED s473t6a (Opus, 2026-09-17) by #1501 ROUND 8 (t6a), CHECK 1 of
t/op/ref.t.  PRE-EXISTING.  15 rows never produced + 11 blessed fail rows.
This is #1433's blast radius measured on a SECOND file, and the drop itself is
the USER-ruled indirect-object non-support (#399, DECIDED s425).

t/op/ref.t line 335:

    $foo = doit $object "FOO";   # Bug. Fell through.

is an indirect-object call with a SCALAR invocant AND arguments, which PCL
refuses (`docs/not-supported.md` "Indirect object syntax with a SCALAR
invocant").  The refusal is a DROP, and the drop's die aborts its enclosing
top-level form -- and that form is a `p-let` for a file-level `my`, so it
spans most of the rest of the file (#1433 measured exactly this shape on
t/op/method.t).

WHAT IS BEHIND IT (rows now carrying this task):
  * 15 rows never produced: t/op/ref.t's `[at â¦ line 483|489|502|503|517]`
    and the unnamed `#137`-`#140`, `#255`-`#257` (the file's shortfall row,
    `baselines/row-shortfall.tsv` `t/op/ref.t` 15).
  * `#120` / `#121` and the `*summary*` renumber.
  * lines 371/372 (`\(@fuu)`, `\(1,@fuu,@baa)` -- the distributive backslash):
    PROBED IDENTICAL to perl in isolation
    (scratch/s473t6a/probes/backslash-list.pl, four shapes), so they fail on
    the file's state, not on their own mechanism.  NOT isolated further.

WHY IT IS FILED SEPARATELY FROM #1433: #1433 is the MEASUREMENT of the blast
radius and lists its options (a) document (b) count rows-behind-a-drop
(c) narrow the emitted form.  This task is the second data point for (b) --
ONE ruled refusal costs 26 rows here -- and the place to record that ref.t is
a candidate for (c), since its `my` is a file-level one whose later uses are
all at top level.
subject: t/op/ref.t: ONE ruled indirect-object drop at line 335 costs 26 rows -- #1433's blast radius measured on a second file
